notes: Stories created for MAINT-CONSENT covering schema, logic, API, tests, and integration.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation Fixes
stories.description: Review and correct Pydantic models and data contracts for two-tier HIPAA consent, ensuring Tier 1 vs Tier 2 fields, flags, and transitions are explicitly defined and validated.

stories.title: Core Consent State Machine Bug Fixes
stories.description: Fix defects in consent_service logic governing transitions between no consent, Tier 1 (de-identified), and Tier 2 (identified) states, including edge cases like partial consent, retries, and invalid escalation paths.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Routing Alignment
stories.description: Ensure tool_router and API layer correctly invoke consent logic with consistent payloads, handling consent prompts, responses, and failures without leaking PHI or bypassing required consent steps.

stories.title: Consent Edge Case and Regression Test Suite
stories.description: Add unit and integration tests covering edge cases including repeated consent prompts, denial flows, session resets, malformed inputs, and correct de-identification behavior under Tier 1.
stories.evidence: GAP: No dedicated consent test suite exists; must be added to backend/tests for consent coverage

stories.title: Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
stories.description: Fix integration points where consent interacts with lead_capture and unknown_question services, ensuring Tier 2 is enforced before identifiable data storage and that fallback flows respect consent boundaries.
